starter:
-- Business customers who have never referred anyone
SELECT customer_id, email, segment
FROM customers
WHERE segment IN ('enterprise', 'small_business')
  AND customer_id NOT IN (SELECT referred_by FROM customers);
solution:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.email, c.segment
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.segment IN ('enterprise', 'small_business')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM customers AS r
    WHERE r.referred_by = c.customer_id
  );
